entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I'm going to start venting now...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Don't expect me to hold back!

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Ow... That hurts more than I thought[n]it would.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: But, that's not all of your feelings yet,[n]is it?

entries.en: We're just getting started. Try to[n]keep up with me!

entries.en: Huh? I'm starting to enjoy this...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Why, though? This hurts so much, but...[n]I'm actually enjoying it?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Wait, I need to focus. Here I come, folks!

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I really understand how you feel now.[n]Thank you.
entries.uk: Тепер я справді розумію, що ви[n]відчуваєте. Дякую.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Now, it's time to show you how I feel!

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: This is what I've learned from studying[n]humans—witness my true feelings!
